name: Neck Side Tilt
steps: Sit up straight and relax your shoulders.
Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder until you feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your neck.
Hold for 30 seconds then repeat on the other side.
camera_instruction: Sit facing the camera so it can see your head tilt to each side.

name: Neck Forward Nod
steps: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed and feet flat on the floor.
Gently tuck your chin toward your chest as if making a double chin.
Hold the position and breathe slowly for 25 seconds.
camera_instruction: Sit with your right side facing the camera so it can see your chin tuck and neck curve.

name: Neck Rotation Stretch
steps: Sit upright with your shoulders down and back.
Slowly turn your head to the right as far as is comfortable without pain.
Hold 15 seconds then turn to the left and hold 15 seconds.
camera_instruction: Stand facing the camera so it can verify your head rotation is even on both sides.

name: Upper Trap Stretch
steps: Sit straight and hold the edge of your chair seat with your right hand.
Tilt your left ear toward your left shoulder and place your left hand lightly on top of your head.
Hold 30 seconds then switch sides.
camera_instruction: Sit facing the camera so it can see your head tilt and confirm your shoulder stays down.

name: Head Circles
steps: Sit tall with eyes looking forward and shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin to your chest then gently roll your head in a half circle to the right and back to center.
Repeat the half circle to the left for a total of 20 seconds.
camera_instruction: Sit with your side facing the camera so it can track the arc of your head movement.

name: Shoulder Roll
steps: Sit or stand tall with your arms resting at your sides.
Roll both shoulders up toward your ears then backward and down in a smooth circle.
Continue rolling slowly for 20 seconds.
camera_instruction: Sit or stand facing the camera so it can see both shoulders moving in equal circles.

name: Doorway Chest Opener
steps: Stand next to your desk and raise both arms to shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Gently press your hands and forearms backward as if pushing against a doorframe.
Hold the open position for 30 seconds and breathe deeply.
camera_instruction: Stand facing the camera with arms raised so it can see your chest opening and elbows at shoulder level.

name: Seated Shoulder Squeeze
steps: Sit up straight with feet flat and hands resting on your thighs.
Draw both shoulder blades toward each other as if trying to hold a pencil between them.
Hold the squeeze for 25 seconds then slowly release.
camera_instruction: Sit facing the camera so it can confirm both shoulder blades are moving equally.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
steps: Sit or stand and bring your right arm straight across your chest at shoulder height.
Use your left hand to gently pull your right arm closer to your body.
Hold 30 seconds then switch arms.
camera_instruction: Stand with your right side facing the camera so it can see your arm crossing your body at the correct height.

name: Chest Stretch Arms Back
steps: Stand up straight and clasp your hands behind your lower back.
Gently straighten your arms and lift your hands slightly while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold the stretch for 25 seconds.
camera_instruction: Stand with your side facing the camera so it can see your arms behind your back and your chest lifting forward.

name: Seated Spinal Twist
steps: Sit tall on your chair with feet flat on the floor.
Place your right hand on the back of the chair and your left hand on your right knee then twist gently to the right.
Hold 30 seconds then repeat twisting to the left.
camera_instruction: Sit with your side facing the camera so it can see the full rotation of your spine.

name: Seated Forward Fold
steps: Sit at the edge of your chair with feet hip-width apart and flat on the floor.
Lean your chest slowly forward toward your thighs and let your hands hang toward the floor.
Hold and breathe deeply for 30 seconds.
camera_instruction: Sit with your side facing the camera so it can measure how far your upper body folds forward.

name: Cat-Cow at Chair
steps: Sit at the edge of your chair with hands on your knees and feet flat.
Arch your lower back and lift your chest toward the ceiling for the cow position then round your back toward the chair for the cat position.
Alternate slowly between the two positions for 30 seconds.
camera_instruction: Sit with your side facing the camera so it can see your spine arching and rounding clearly.

name: Standing Back Extension
steps: Stand behind your chair and place your hands on the backrest for light support.
Gently place your hands on your lower back and lean backward a small comfortable amount.
Hold the extension for 20 seconds and breathe steadily.
camera_instruction: Stand with your side facing the camera so it can see the backward arch in your lower back.

name: Seated Hip Flexor Shift
steps: Sit at the front edge of your chair and slide your right foot back so it rests behind the chair leg.
Keep your back straight and gently press your hips forward to feel a stretch in your right hip.
Hold 35 seconds then switch legs.
camera_instruction: Sit with your side facing the camera so it can confirm your back stays upright while your hip flexes.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
steps: Extend your right arm straight in front of you with the palm facing up.
Use your left hand to gently pull your right fingers downward toward the floor.
Hold 25 seconds then switch to the other hand.
camera_instruction: Hold your arm out toward the camera so it can see the angle of your wrist bend clearly.

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
steps: Extend your right arm straight out in front of you with the palm facing down.
Use your left hand to gently press the back of your right hand downward.
Hold 25 seconds then switch hands.
camera_instruction: Hold your arm straight out toward the camera so it can see the top of your wrist bending downward.

name: Forearm Pronation Stretch
steps: Hold your right arm out to the side at shoulder height with your palm facing up.
Slowly rotate your forearm so your palm faces down and hold the end position.
Continue alternating slowly for 20 seconds then repeat with the left arm.
camera_instruction: Face the camera with your arm extended sideways so it can see the rotation of your palm clearly.

name: Prayer Stretch
steps: Press your palms together in front of your chest in a prayer position with fingers pointing up.
Slowly lower your joined hands toward your waist while keeping your palms pressed together.
Hold the lowest comfortable position for 30 seconds.
camera_instruction: Face the camera with your hands centered on your chest so it can track the angle of your wrists.

name: Finger Fan Stretch
steps: Hold both hands out in front of you at chest height with palms facing away from you.
Spread all your fingers as wide apart as possible like a fan.
Hold the spread for 5 seconds then relax and repeat the fan motion slowly for 20 seconds total.
camera_instruction: Hold your hands up facing the camera so it can see all fingers spreading fully and evenly.
